verdict.rationale: Simular documents a REST API, Python SDK and MCP server that give developers 'the same autonomous computer.' The API covers the core loop: submitting plain-language tasks, streaming progress via `GET /v1/agents/events`, answering approval requests via `POST /v1/agents/approve`, and listing machines via `GET /v1/agents/machines`. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches the UI across the rest of the product. Missing for 10: API coverage of saving and sharing skills, scheduled reruns, workflow templates, BYOD device setup, watching computers live, and notification settings; an explicit UI/API parity statement; a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404); independent corroboration.
